words.hint: Don't forget the m: it's a PUMP plus KIN, so you pump air into your kin's pumpkin!
words.sentence: We carved a spooky face into our pumpkin and put it on the doorstep for Halloween.

words.hint: It ends in TERN, like the seabird: a tern flew by carrying a lantern.
words.sentence: Grandad held up a lantern so we could find our way along the dark garden path.

words.hint: Split it into HAR + VEST: the farmer wears a VEST at harvest time.
words.sentence: Our class brought tins of food to school for the harvest festival.
